text: In accordance with Section 21 of the Rules of Procedure, the Chair of the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal has granted a request for review and has ordered a review hearing to rehear appeal DDRT2019-05 in whole.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Rescinded the determination of a dangerous dog, exempted the applicant from compliance with the Dangerous Dog Order issued December 14, 2018, and directed that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Scott Currie and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before October 30, 2019.
